ab: ab, ā (prep. + abl.) — from, away from; by

mihi: ego, meī — I; mihi, to/for me (dat.)
moenia: moenia, -ium (n. pl.) — walls, city walls (nom./acc. pl.)

nec: nec, neque — and not, nor; nec… nec, neither… nor
neque: neque (nec) — and not, nor; neque enim, for indeed… not
nos: ego, meī — I; nōs, we, us (nom./acc. pl.)
notus: Notus, -ī (m.) — Notus, the south wind (nom. sg.)
nunc: nunc (adv.) — now, at present; nunc… nunc, now… now

pectore: pectus, pectoris (n.) — breast, chest; heart (abl. sg.)

per: per (prep. + acc.) — through, across, throughout; by
pius: pius, -a, -um — dutiful, devout, loyal (m. nom. sg.)
prima: prīmus, -a, -um — first, foremost (f. nom. sg.; n. nom./acc. pl.)
primum: prīmus, -a, -um — first; prīmum (adv.), first, at first (n. acc. sg. as adv.)

quam: quī, quae, quod — who, which (rel., f. acc. sg.); quam (adv.), how; than · prius… quam (conj.), before, until
qui: quī, quae, quod — who, which (rel. pron., m. nom. sg./pl.)
quibus: quī, quae, quod — who, which (rel., abl./dat. pl.)

quos: quī, quae, quod — who, which (rel. or interrog., m. acc. pl.)
regit: regō, regere, rēxī, rēctum — to rule, guide, direct (3rd sg. pres.)
rerum: rēs, reī (f.) — thing, matter; pl. circumstances, fortunes (gen. pl.)
sed: sed (conj.) — but; sed enim, but indeed
sese: sē, sēsē — emphatic reflexive, himself, itself, themselves (acc.)
sic: sīc (adv.) — so, thus, in this way
sinus: sinus, -ūs (m.) — curve, bay, hollow, fold (acc. pl.; nom./acc. sg.)
sub: sub (prep.) — + abl. under, beneath; + acc. up to, under
summa: summus, -a, -um — highest, topmost; surface of (f. abl. sg.; n. nom./acc. pl.)
summo: summus, -a, -um — highest, topmost; surface of (m./n. abl./dat. sg.)
super: super (adv. and prep.) — above, over; besides, in addition
talibus: tālis, -e — such, of such a kind (abl./dat. pl.)
tegmine: tegmen, tegminis (n.) — covering, hide, skin (abl. sg.)

tum: tum (adv.) — then, at that time; next
una: ūnus, -a, -um — one, a single (f. abl./nom. sg.); ūnā (adv.), together
ut: ut (conj.) — + subj. so that, in order that; + indic. as, when, how

vos: tū, vōs — you (2nd pers. pl. pron.) (nom./acc. pl.)
